case_definitions.Noise: insert; p stays noise, all old labels unchanged
case_definitions.Creation: insert; a new cluster appears made only of p and former noise points
case_definitions.Absorption: insert; p joins exactly one existing cluster (former noise may join too), no merge
case_definitions.Merge: insert; one new cluster contains >= 2 old clusters
case_definitions.Removal: delete; an old cluster loses all its remaining members to noise (cluster vanishes)
case_definitions.Reduction: delete; cluster shrinks or loses cores, but the UpdSeed cores are already directly eps-linked (no connectivity search)
case_definitions.PotentialSplit_NonSplit: delete; UpdSeed cores of an old cluster are not directly linked (search needed) but stay connected
case_definitions.PotentialSplit_Split: delete; an old cluster falls apart into >= 2 clusters
case_definitions.DeleteNoise: delete of a point that was noise (natural streams only)

id_note: point_id is never reused; a re-inserted point gets a new id. Delete rows carry the deleted point's coordinates for convenience.
ambiguous_note: ambiguous_border_ids lists, AFTER the step, border points within eps of cores of >= 2 clusters; planted events never fall on such points; exclude them when comparing labels (ARI) with a full re-fit.
